caption: The drawing shows a central human-like figure standing upright and facing forward, wearing a bright red conical hat, a red tunic with black detailing down the front center, and beige legs. The figure’s face is pale, with outlined eyes, a small nose, and a neutral mouth. Each arm is outstretched horizontally; the left arm (on the viewer’s right) holds a dark, elongated fish hanging vertically by the mouth, while the right arm (on the viewer’s left) is empty and bent upwards, with long thin fingers spread apart. Behind the figure are two symmetrical, black, arched shapes resembling stylized wings, each with red lining and short black vertical lines along the lower arch. There are two simple black shapes resembling sideways “X” marks near the upper corners of the rectangular inner frame, with an additional looped line near the upper left corner. At the bottom left of the figure, there is a brown semi-oval shape on a short stem with small dark round circles extending from its edges, resembling a mushroom or stylized tree. The entire composition is set within a double border with an inner brownish-tan field and an outer red line. The background inside the border is a light tan color with uneven, watercolor-like shading, and the rest of the page is a plain, off-white color.
title: Retabla
